evidence.S1: Consistent cards and dark mode, but the scrolled Overview banner overlaps the header and the share preview is tiny.
evidence.S2: Status reads 'Listening - 2 found' while speaking; a toast offers Edit and Undo.
evidence.S3: Budget card gives used, %, per-day allowance, and month-end projection; chart bars open that day's expenses.
evidence.S4: Story card keeps content inside the UI-free zone, but the share-sheet preview is small and cramped.
evidence.S5: Works offline, CSV export, JSON backup/restore, last-backup date, storage-full warning, and persistent storage request.

fixes: Fix the scrolled Overview budget banner overlap and make the share-sheet preview large enough to read.
Add full-size share previews for Square, dark mode, and Chinese/Indonesian, and verify no cramped labels or safe-zone collisions.
Add explicit voice capture offline/error/retry states so failed speech input is recoverable without losing intent.

evidence.S1: Clean typography hierarchy with large totals, consistent bottom nav, both light/dark themes coherent, Chinese and Indonesian localizations look proper; minor rough edges: record sheet packs many controls (mic, parsed rows, category chips, Save) into one screen, and Overview budget card subtext is quite small.
evidence.S2: One-tap mic, live parsing ('Listening - 2 found'), instant 'No amount found', per-row tap to edit category/amount, toast with Edit and Undo after save - matches the 10 anchor exactly.
evidence.S3: Totals with 'vs same point last month', budget with used/%/per-day/projection, spending-by-day chart with peak and average labels, drill-down on bar tap, budget-pace tick, logging streak, days under budget - covers pace, comparisons and drill-down.
evidence.S4: Full-size Story card shows poster-grade layout (TALLY wordmark, month, NT$3,950, -24% delta, budget-pace line, 4-stat grid, top-3 categories with bars, voice footer); UI-free zone y=250-1670 verified; 8 backgrounds, transparent PNG, photo, Hide amounts, Story/Square.
evidence.S5: Empty states are CTAs with mic badge + 'Log by voice'/'Add manually' >=44px; offline service worker, CSV export, JSON backup/restore with last-backup date, storage-full warning, persistent storage request, region-driven currency/format/voice/language, 0 a11y failures over 77 screens.

fixes: Simplify the record sheet layout - it currently stacks mic, parsed rows, category chips and Save in one dense view; consider a step-by-step or collapsible pattern to reduce cognitive load.
Increase the size/contrast of the Overview budget card subtext ('$8,137 of $30,000', '30%') so the pace and projection read at a glance without zooming.
Tighten spacing and visual grouping on the Activity list - category icons, amounts and dates are close together; more breathing room would push it from 'clean' to 'shipped finance app'.

evidence.S1: Screens are clean and consistent across light/dark and EN/ID/ZH; rough edges: budget input shows bare '30000' with no currency/separators ('Monthly budget 30000', '$9,137 of 30,000'), and awkward localized header 'TANPA TANGAN DENGAN SIRI'.
evidence.S2: 'both expenses are parsed live and saved when you stop talking; a toast offers Edit and Undo', status 'Listening - 2 found', rows 'tapped to change category or amount, or removed' - only friction is undo living in a transient toast.
evidence.S3: Pace ('$669 per day available for the remaining 24 days... $9,159 over budget', today tick), comparison ('+100% vs same point last month ($4,570)'), trend (avg/peak labelled chart), drill-down ('Tap a bar to see that day') and category breakdown all present.
evidence.S4: Full-size Story card is poster-grade and 'all content sits between y=250 and y=1670... measured by alpha bounds'; but only one background/language is shown at full size, and photo-background legibility is unevidenced.
evidence.S5: 'Works offline (service worker), CSV export, JSON backup/restore... storage-full warning, persistent storage request'; empty states are strong CTAs ('Log by voice' / 'Add manually', >=44 px); no evidence for mic-permission-denied, unsupported speech recognition, or corrupt-backup restore.

fixes: Harden capture/restore failure paths: handle microphone-permission denial and devices without speech recognition (and clarify whether voice needs connectivity while the app is offline), plus reject/cleanly handle an invalid JSON backup on restore.

Make post-save correction durable: don't strand Edit/Undo in a transient toast - add a persistent just-saved chip or voice correction ('change lunch to 150') so a missed toast doesn't turn undo into a multi-tap hunt in Activity.

Close polish gaps: currency-format budget inputs ('30000' -> '$30,000'), fix awkward machine-translated strings (e.g. ID 'TANPA TANGAN DENGAN SIRI'), and verify all 8 share backgrounds x shapes x languages at full size for poster-grade output.
